page.overview:
Who is Bib'vena's mother?

A female freedom fighter with a strong sense of ethics, the mother of Bib'vena, a Rutian Twi'lek, passed this morality on to the child. He also became a freedom fighter, in the Anoat sector shortly after the Battle of Endor There, Bib'vena assisted The Smuggler, leader of the Uprising rebel group that fought against Governor Ubrik Adelhard and his Imperial remnant.

Bib'vena's mother was mentioned in the 2015 mobile game Star Wars: Uprising by entertainment company Kabam.
